rules.name: Vertical reframing
rules.condition: IF aspect_ratio == '9:16' THEN reframe_scheduled = True
rules.recommendation: Apply vertical (9:16) reframing.

rules.name: Generate subtitles from transcript
rules.condition: IF subtitles_enabled AND has_transcript THEN subtitles_scheduled = True
rules.recommendation: Generate subtitles from transcript timestamps.

rules.name: Subtitles requested without transcript
rules.condition: IF subtitles_enabled AND NOT has_transcript THEN subtitles_blocked = True

rules.name: Mix background music with ducking
rules.condition: IF music_enabled THEN music_ducking = True

rules.name: Focus-aware crop
rules.condition: IF reframe_scheduled AND source_wider_than_target THEN focus_crop = True
rules.recommendation: Crop around the detected motion focus instead of the frame centre.
rules.explanation: Vertical reframing is scheduled and the source is wider than the target.

rules.name: Short-form profile
rules.condition: IF reframe_scheduled AND target_duration <= 60 THEN short_form_profile = True
rules.recommendation: Treat as short-form content (fast pacing, burned-in captions).
rules.explanation: Vertical output of 60 s or less matches short-form platform conventions.

rules.name: Loudness normalisation
rules.condition: IF normalize_audio THEN loudnorm = True
rules.recommendation: Apply EBU R128 loudness normalisation.

rules.name: Vertical reel ready
rules.condition: IF aspect_ratio == '9:16' AND reframe_scheduled AND resolution_vertical AND duration_ok_for_short_form THEN vertical_reel_ready = True
rules.recommendation: All requirements for a vertical reel are satisfied.
rules.explanation: 9:16 aspect, reframing scheduled, vertical resolution and short-form duration.

rules.name: Vertical resolution
rules.condition: IF out_height > <out_width> THEN resolution_vertical = True
rules.recommendation: Output is portrait.

rules.name: Duration fits short-form
rules.condition: IF target_duration <= 90 THEN duration_ok_for_short_form = True
rules.recommendation: Duration fits Reels/Shorts limits.

rules.name: Transition at poor continuity
rules.condition: IF visual_discontinuity > <continuity_threshold> AND transitions_enabled THEN transition_needed = True
rules.recommendation: Insert a transition between these scenes.
rules.explanation: Consecutive scenes differ strongly in appearance.

rules.name: Soft dissolve for jump cuts
